reviews.title: Great for use inside a computer, not so much for external testing
reviews.comment: This is the second ATX style extender I’ve purchased. The first was not StarTech brand. The StarTech harness has fairly stiff wires. I was hoping for a little more flexibility as I’m using it to test boards outside the case, but it still does work. The connectors are also a little tighter to plug in than my other ATX extender- not a deal breaker, just requires a little more effort. For a permanent installation, this likely doesn’t matter.
reviews.author: Garrett Bunge

reviews.title: Made adapters for ATX to HP motherboards.
reviews.comment: I've purchased these 3 times to make adapters for standard ATX 24-pin to HP Z400 motherboards 24-pin connections.  These are high quality extensions and have worked quite well after the modifications to pull 2 wires from one end and solder them to 2 other wires midway between the connectors.  (You'll need a good soldering gun to solder that many wires.)  Insulated soldered connection with  3M(TM) Temflex(TM) Rubber Splicing Tape 2155 - 3/4x22FT but vinyl tape would work.
reviews.author: Timothy K Knechtly

reviews.title: Avoided the need to use a cable stretcher
reviews.comment: Worked great, eliminated strained connections from the original PS cable being just barely long enough to connect to the new MB.  No issues with pins staying put.  Would use again without concern, but to be fair, I have not had a need to disconnect and reconnect it much after installing it.
